description: Create a free API key (English cards, 250 requests/month) for an email address. Free keys are for PERSONAL, NON-COMMERCIAL use only: confirm that with the user before setting personal_use=true. Commercial use, other languages, printings and images need a paid plan (POST /v1/billing). Pass the key as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

personal_use.description: true = the user agrees the free key is for personal, non-commercial use (https://api.master-setter.com/terms)

name: get_api_key
